data.content: Plan review: APPROVED. Plan addresses all 4 acceptance criteria: (1) post-write enrichment/release failures downgraded to stderr warnings with exit 0 via best-effort enrichment scoped to post-write sites (state_ops.rs tail, state_fail_ops.rs scan+tail, execute_next release); (2) show -j regression test locks RFC 8259 validity (defect not reproducible at HEAD; serde_json escapes correctly); (3) lease_guard.rs:110 message gains bound lease id; (4) regression tests T1-T3 cover all three. Risks identified and mitigated: enrichment stays fallible on read paths. Proceed to implementation.
